**Evaluate Your Commitment**

One major obstacle to motivation is commitment. Your level of motivation to complete a task is directly related to how committed you are to complete the task.

Commitment works best when there are rewards and punishments for a task. If you understand the reward for completing the task you are more likely to complete the task. If you know what you stand to lose by not completing to task you are more likely to complete the task.

To become more committed, try visualizing your life having completing the task. It should be a clear image. If you learn this language, you will be able to mingle with the locals during your vacation. If you workout regularly, you'll be able to play with your grandkids when you get older.
